turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on weather words?
turns.tutor:
Let me think aloud with a clue: "There is thunder and lightning." Thunder and lightning mean a storm, so I describe the day as stormy. I spell it s-t-o-r-m-y. Then I use it: "It is stormy, so we stay at home."
Right: "It is stormy." Wrong: "It is storm." Storm is the thing itself; after It is we need the describing word.
Now your turn. Use the first sentence as your clue, then write one word:
Complete: "Take an umbrella. It is ___ today."
